---
# Probe page for images/html-grid-anatomy.svg (built by build-anatomy.R).
# Default grid options. The margin block makes Quarto use the default grid,
# the same grid as a document with a table of contents on the right.
format:
  html:
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <style>
        .blk { border-radius: 2px; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
        .blk-body { background: #d6d6d6; height: 110px; }
        .blk-margin { background: #efc7d3; height: 80px; }
        .blk-page { background: #b9cfe2; height: 50px; }
        </style>
---

::: column-margin
::: {.blk .blk-margin}
:::
:::

::: {.column-body .blk .blk-body}
:::

::: {.column-page .blk .blk-page}
:::

::: {.column-body .blk .blk-body .blk-body-2}
:::
